code_after.external_scope: compiler, SDK, codec and shared-library details retained in build manifest; not reread as project source

code_before.external_scope: compiler, SDK, codec and shared-library details retained in build manifest; not reread as project source

timing_contract.environment: runner and children share one permitted logical CPU; no exclusive ownership or cache flushing
timing_contract.excluded: one-time copied-evidence/source preparation, oracle loading, identity checks outside sessions, explicitly timed full-byte/descriptors/LRU/resource/wire audits, serialization of raw records after close
timing_contract.included: readiness, all twelve full admissions, queries, preparation, Capture, full JSONL/hex or SFC1/raw transfer and identical Python materialization, STATS after admissions and queries, shutdown, control bookkeeping and untimed assertions
timing_contract.observer_effect: subtracting timed audit work does not reverse its cache, allocator or scheduling effects
timing_contract.phase_diagnostics: native phase clocks overlap client clocks; row framing is the controlled factor, not a separately isolated causal timer
timing_contract.primary: service_ms = spawn-through-close raw_session_wall_ms minus explicitly timed oracle/audit intervals
timing_contract.statistics: fresh-process paired observations by repetition; ranges are descriptive, not confidence intervals
timing_contract.wire_scope: bytes actually consumed from native stdout and written to native stdin, including STATS and QUIT; not physical I/O or RSS
